# Routledge
> Routledge is a global academic publisher of books, textbooks, reference works, and digital resources across the humanities, social sciences, behavioral sciences, education, and related fields.

Part of Taylor & Francis, Routledge serves researchers, instructors, students, librarians, and authors with subject browsing, textbook support, publishing guidance, book series, and customer services.

## Discover and Browse
- [Subjects](https://www.routledge.com/subjects): Browse books and resources by academic discipline and subject area.
- [New and Bestselling Books](https://www.routledge.com/new-and-bestselling-books): Explore recent releases, popular titles, and current bestsellers.
- [Book Lists](https://www.routledge.com/book-lists): Find curated reading lists, themed collections, and featured selections.
- [Series](https://www.routledge.com/book-series): Browse Routledge book series across disciplines and research areas.
- [Textbooks](https://www.routledge.com/textbooks): Discover textbooks for higher education teaching and course adoption.
- [eBooks](https://www.routledge.com/ebooks): Explore digital book offerings for individual and institutional access.

## Subjects and Disciplines
- [Education](https://www.routledge.com/education): Books and resources for teaching, learning, and educational research.
- [Psychology](https://www.routledge.com/psychology): Academic and professional titles across psychology and mental health.
- [Sociology](https://www.routledge.com/sociology): Research and teaching resources in sociology and social theory.
- [Politics & International Relations](https://www.routledge.com/politics): Titles covering political science, public policy, and global affairs.
- [History](https://www.routledge.com/history): Scholarly books and reference works in historical studies.
- [Media & Cultural Studies](https://www.routledge.com/media-cultural-studies): Publications in media, communication, and cultural analysis.
- [Business, Management and Economics](https://www.routledge.com/business): Books for business, management, finance, and economics.
- [Geography, Planning, Urban & Environment](https://www.routledge.com/geography): Resources in geography, planning, urban studies, and environment.

## Textbooks and Instructor Support
- [Instructors](https://www.routledge.com/our-customers/instructors): Overview of services and support for course instructors.
- [Inspection Copies](https://www.routledge.com/our-customers/instructors/textbooks/inspection-copies): Request inspection or exam copies for textbook evaluation.
- [Companion Websites](https://www.routledge.com/our-customers/instructors/companion-websites): Access online companion materials supporting adopted textbooks.
- [Desk Copies](https://www.routledge.com/our-customers/instructors/textbooks/desk-copies): Information about desk copies for confirmed course adoptions.
- [How to Use Our Textbooks](https://www.routledge.com/our-customers/instructors/textbooks): Guidance on textbook adoption and instructor textbook services.

## Authors and Publishing
- [Authors](https://www.routledge.com/our-customers/authors): Publishing information, benefits, and support for prospective and current authors.
- [Publish with Us](https://www.routledge.com/our-customers/authors/publish-with-us): Learn how to propose a book and publish with Routledge.
- [Book Proposals](https://www.routledge.com/our-customers/authors/book-proposals): Guidance on preparing and submitting a book proposal.
- [Author Services](https://www.routledge.com/our-customers/authors/author-services): Support resources for authors during publication and promotion.
- [Editorial Contacts](https://www.routledge.com/contacts/editorial): Find commissioning editor contacts by subject and region.
- [Open Access Books](https://www.routledge.com/our-customers/authors/open-access-books): Information about open access publishing options for books.

## Librarians and Institutions
- [Librarians](https://www.routledge.com/our-customers/librarians): Services and information for academic and institutional librarians.
- [eCollections](https://www.routledge.com/our-customers/librarians/ecollections): Explore digital collections for institutional acquisition and access.
- [Reference Works](https://www.routledge.com/reference-works): Browse major reference titles and scholarly handbooks.
- [Book Series](https://www.routledge.com/book-series): Identify ongoing scholarly series relevant to library collections.
- [eBooks for Libraries](https://www.routledge.com/ebooks): Digital book access options useful for institutional collections.

## Featured Collections and Series
- [Routledge Classics](https://www.routledge.com/book-lists/routledge-classics): Explore the Routledge Classics collection of influential works.
- [Routledge Companions](https://www.routledge.com/Routledge-Companions/book-series/ROUTCOMPS): Browse the Routledge Companions reference series across disciplines.
- [The Psychology of Everything](https://www.routledge.com/The-Psychology-of-Everything/book-series/PSYCH): Accessible psychology series on everyday topics and issues.
- [Critical Introductions to Urbanism and the City](https://www.routledge.com/Critical-Introductions-to-Urbanism-and-the-City/book-series/CIUC): Introductory urban studies series for students and researchers.
- [Routledge Focus](https://www.routledge.com/Routledge-Focus/book-series/FOCUS): Short-form books addressing timely research topics and debates.

## Support and Customer Service
- [Customer Service](https://www.routledge.com/contacts/customer-service): Contact support for orders, accounts, and general assistance.
- [Editorial Contacts](https://www.routledge.com/contacts/editorial): Reach editorial teams and commissioning editors by subject.
- [Rights and Permissions](https://www.routledge.com/contacts/rights-and-permissions): Request permissions and rights information for Routledge content.
- [Inspection Copies Help](https://www.routledge.com/our-customers/instructors/textbooks/inspection-copies): Support for inspection copy eligibility and requests.
- [Contact Us](https://www.routledge.com/contacts): Central directory for Routledge contact information.

## About Routledge
- [About Us](https://www.routledge.com/about-us): Learn about Routledge, its history, and publishing mission.
- [Our Customers](https://www.routledge.com/our-customers): Entry point for instructors, authors, students, and librarians.
- [Careers at Taylor & Francis](https://careers.taylorandfrancis.com): Explore career opportunities across the wider publishing group.
- [Taylor & Francis Group](https://www.taylorandfrancis.com): Corporate site for the parent publishing organization.

## News and Insights
- [Routledge Blog](https://blog.routledge.com): Articles, author insights, teaching ideas, and publishing news.
- [Book Lists](https://www.routledge.com/book-lists): Editorially curated lists highlighting themes, events, and disciplines.
- [New and Bestselling Books](https://www.routledge.com/new-and-bestselling-books): Current highlights from new releases and popular titles.
- [Sale](https://www.routledge.com/sale): Current promotions and discounted academic books.
